report.summary: All four failures share one root cause: app/main.py:150 makes list_books sleep a random 0-8 seconds on every /books render, and the UI tests allow only 5 s (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). Whenever the sleep runs long, page.goto('/books') or the register-redirect navigation times out, so the outcome is random rather than a consistent regression. Fix the app's random latency first (remove the sleep or make it deterministic), then rerun the UI suite to confirm all four pass.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in list_books makes /books page loads exceed the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database (app/main.py:149-150). render_books() calls list_books() on every /books render (app/main.py:256), and the post-register redirect lands on /books (app/main.py:297, 235). The UI fixture sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). When the random delay is above roughly 5 s, Playwright's 'load' wait for /books times out. About 37% of renders should exceed 5 s, so the same code can pass on a rerun. The three books tests fail at page.goto('/books') in BooksPage.open (tests/support/pages.py:34). The login test fails at the Register submit click, which waits for the scheduled navigation to /books to finish (tests/support/pages.py:22). The test code itself appears correct; the delay is in the application. The traces are consistent with this, but I did not reproduce a timing measurement, so confidence is medium-high rather than certain.
evidence: Failure: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63061/books", waiting until "load" (test_added_book_is_listed, test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input)
Failure: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63060/books", waiting until "load" (test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui)
Failure: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf, page url /register)
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep from list_books in app/main.py:150, since it is not needed for any product behavior and is only a source of nondeterminism. If the delay is meant to simulate slow backends, put it behind an environment flag that is off in tests, or move it into a dedicated test that tolerates it. Do not raise the UI timeout as the main fix, because it only hides the randomness. Then rerun the UI suite several times to confirm stability.
